note: Illinois Department of Agriculture campground inside Gate 3 at the north end of the Du Quoin State Fairgrounds (off US 51), along the fairgrounds lake: pavilions, a playground and fishing docks (bank fishing only). Horse shows, races and flea markets fill the grounds on many spring-to-autumn weekends. --Claude
summary: Fairgrounds camping page read; imagery viewed. Season Apr 1-Oct 31 (closed Nov-Mar), no reservations, 30/50-amp + water, 2 bathhouses with showers, 2 dumps confirmed from the page; $25 non-tent confirmed with +$10 holiday week and the veteran/60+ $20 rate recorded. Ordinary nightly camping outside events confirmed. Lakeview kept (lead below).
flags: FAIRGROUNDS NIGHTS: ordinary nightly camping is sold outside events - the page posts regular nightly rates ('Non-tent $25'), 'Reservations are not required, nor accepted', season April-Oct 31; only the fair itself ('Rates are not applicable during the Du Quoin State Fair August through Labor Day') is excluded. Passes the fairgrounds test.

WATERFRONT LEAD (lakeview kept, checked hard): on Esri imagery the pin sits on the lake-side loop (two parallel lanes) inside Gate 3. Mowed site stripes run east from the east lane (~37.9903,-89.2280) and end ~20 m short of the fairgrounds lake (a ~100 m wide, ~1 km long lake, well over 5 acres); between them and the water is open mowed lawn with a mown path and two fishing docks, no screen. A rig parked on those stripes could be ~20-45 m from the water over open grass, which the open-apron rule could call lakefront. Not upgraded: there is no site map or site numbering anywhere on the operator's pages, so I cannot name the sites or show they are pads rather than mowing lines; the waterfront rule wants named sites. Reviewer may want official photos.
DISCOUNTS: military written true from the posted Veteran rate ($20 vs $25); the note says it is veterans and 60+.
TENT LIMIT: tent sites are 'limited to 5 consecutive days' (tent only; no limit stated for RVs).
PHONE: 618-542-1515 (Administration Office) matches the page; the page also gives the Camping Host line 618-318-0829 ('hours vary'). Reviewer may add it: 618-542-1515 -> 618-542-1515,618-318-0829.
Pin 37.9903,-89.2286 is on the lake-side camping loop inside Gate 3: OK (the 1,000+ sites spread wider; no site map to compute a centroid).
